rows.label: joined-page-existing-indexes
rows.sql:
SELECT c.native_id,c.title,m.is_starred FROM session_catalog c
 LEFT JOIN session_identities i ON i.native_family=c.family AND i.native_scope=c.native_storage_scope AND i.native_id=c.native_id
 LEFT JOIN session_metadata m ON m.session_id=i.session_id
 WHERE c.deleted=0 ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC,c.native_id ASC LIMIT 51
plan: SCAN c
SEARCH i USING COVERING INDEX session_native_binding (native_family=? AND native_scope=? AND native_id=?) LEFT-JOIN
SEARCH m USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_session_metadata_1 (session_id=?) LEFT-JOIN
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
